notes.summary: The continuation describes arbitrary suprema by saturation of a union, then says Je [dis struck] présume that the supports form a Boolean algebra. Its long oblique note says this should hold in the set-like case and named examples, relates Sigma to parts of E and a Stone compactification, and states difficulty proving the written three-support distributivity formula. The body describes supports as clopen parts of a spectrum and involution as complementation. It then says the construction depends on the ordered M with compatibility, gives a cosupport set definition, and cites connected components as examples using C4. These are the manuscript’s statements, not proved results of this run.
math_reading_decisions: The recognizable distributivity pattern prompted inspection of each P,Q,R, wedge, vee and delimiter. The visible extra opening hook and terminal curled mark remain in place with alternatives; the formula was not regularized to an expected form.

The inserted compatibility relation has a curled form; the tuple uses a plainer R, and the displayed relation has a pronounced outside oval. Alphabets were read locally, not selected solely from mathematical roles.

The short mark high to the right of Phi is placed first as a prime, with displaced bar and unrelated-mark interpretations retained. No choice between realization and closure was made from the argument.
The final M mark in the quantifier domain has two joined short legs; one returned prime and two linked primes remain alternatives, despite the expected match with earlier M-prime.
Cosup has one descending p. All M forms are plain; the x letters are smaller than M and read lowercase. Case and alphabet changes alone are not treated as changed mathematical assertions.

The compact word is graphically abbreviated or severely reduced: cpct and cpt precede compact among the alternatives. It is not expanded silently. Stone remains uncertain where body text crosses its ending.
author_checks: Je [dis struck] présume is preserved with its raised insertion and connector. The qualified statement is not converted into a theorem.
The oblique je ne vois comment prouver sequence retains local doubts. Root inspected the previously unframed ne vois continuation; no pas-sized word is supplied.
Il faudra y revenir is completely struck through. The cancelled groups around the compact word remain transcribed with their doubts.
The bottom example explicitly says utiliser C4. This is the author’s reference; C4 was not proved or reapplied as a check by this run.
Witness S row SA21-K7-10 is locally confirmed as referring to a conjectural distributivity claim. Its later refutation lies outside these images and remains an unverified witness report here.

workflow_note: Three fresh isolated readers used v05 and each viewed whole/halves once, then their own 11/20/11 crops. Root viewed 21 existing reader crops: all11 R1; R2 02,06,10,11,13,18,20; R3 01,03,11. Two new root crops supplied the separate involution continuation and the still-open marginal ne vois tail. Root a01 clipped the high head of passage, already agreeing in C/H; the existing R3 crop03 supplied it without recropping. R3 honestly disclosed that its tail crop did not securely frame ne vois, leading to root’s new complete target. The three returns were compared after completion. A text-only audit identified the missing detached low stroke and a separate H ill placeholder before Sigma, and checked quotation/count scopes. R3’s string yes/no flags were not used for totals; consolidated flags are booleans. All listed crops were actually displayed. No OCR, outside research, compilation or mathematical validation occurred.
